items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: I see we used him in the tuxedo band, George, and we played him funeral march

ctx.x: I see we used him in the tuxedo band, George, and we played him funeral march, and good memory he played, just like he was. But during that time, like I say, like dance music, that he didn't know anything with music. Yeah. Just all gin. A lot of times they'd make up different things, you know, call it the onion rags and all that kind of stuff like that.

Yeah, they'd make it up like that and play. That's the way it was. I wanted to ask something about the, something about the clubs over here. Yeah. How many different clubs can you, I know now there's the Wolves up in Gretna. Well during this time there's the Wolves, that's in Gretna, and they have the young men's. That's still here down on Homer's side.
